statement.zh: 考古研究将拉皮塔表述为以齿印戳刺陶器为标志、自俾斯麦群岛向远大洋洲扩散的早期大洋洲考古复合体（Kirch；Green）。
statement.en: Research frames Lapita as an early Oceanic archaeological complex marked by dentate-stamped pottery, dispersing from the Bismarck Archipelago into Remote Oceania (Kirch; Green).
